slides.title: AI Updates 1 DeepSeek V3.2 685 Bln params
slides.text: AI Updates 1 DeepSeek V3.2 685 Bln params open-source rivals GPT-5 and Gemini 3.0 Pro Features: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) for long context; Scalable reinforcement learning framework; Large-scale agentic task synthesis pipeline to generates training data DeepSeek V3-standard & V3.2-Speciale , Speciale is a high-compute version that achieved gold-medal in the 2025 International Math Olympiad and International Olympiad in Informatics Both models are open-weight with full technical documentation, allowing developers to fine-tune and deploy on their own hardware The standard V3.2 is available via app, web, and API, while Speciale is temporarily API-only until December 15. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vvrGcWLqMq0 https://api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news251201 Google Imagen 4 in Google Docs, Slides, Vids https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Hi-PeBYi60 Users can create high-quality images by typing prompts within these tools Photorealism, fine details, good text rendering, up to 2K resolution Need to enable AI features in your settings

slides.text: Mistral 3 Family of Models Mistral 3 Family of Models Released Dec 2, 2025 0 open-source Apache 2.0 Mistral Large 3 - MoE 675 Bln (41 Bln active) Ministral 3 dense models:  3B, 8B, and 14B params All Mistral 3 models are multimodal (processing both text and images) and multilingual The smaller Ministral 3 models are specifically optimized for edge computing applications and can run on devices with as little as 4GB of video memory, enabling deployment on smartphones, drones, and embedded systems Available via AWS Bedrock, IBM Watsonx, Microsoft Azure, and NVIDIA infrastructure https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/mistral-frontier-open-models/ https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-3

slides.title: AI Updates 2 Anthropic addressed MCP's scaling problem
slides.text: AI Updates 2 Anthropic addressed MCP's scaling problem Tool Search Tool enables on-demand tool discovery, reducing token usage by 85% while improving accuracy from 49% to 74% on Opus 4 and 79.5% to 88.1% on Opus 4.5 Programmatic Tool Calling lets Claude write Python code to orchestrate multiple tool calls, keeping intermediate results in a sandbox and reducing tokens by 37% Tool Use Examples allow developers to provide sample tool calls directly in definitions, improving parameter accuracy from 72% to 90% These complementary features solve context bloat, wrong tool selection, and parameter errors without abandoning MCP https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6x5G5Lam1Wk Docker's new MCP Toolkit simplifies MCP server setup One-click installations from Docker Desktop It provides access to over 260 verified containerized MCP servers that integrate with AI coding assistants like Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue Dev, and VS Code Previously, users needed to manually configure MCPs through third-party registries, manage dependencies, and edit JSON files. Now the toolkit handles everything automatically in secure containerized environments. The video demonstrates installing Playwright MCP and using it in Cursor to scrape website content into JSON. This eliminates DevOps overhead and makes it dramatically easier to enhance AI agents with external tools and capabilities. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ButAp5rF69E

slides.title: AI Updates 3 Google AI Studio - voice
slides.text: AI Updates 3 Google AI Studio - voice AI agent in under 2 minutes The creator shows building (without coding) a business voice agent that can book appointments, answer questions, and handle client intake The system generates HTML, JavaScript, and CSS code automatically, creating both the conversational AI and user interface The voice quality rivals premium services like 11 Labs, with natural-sounding conversation that maintains context throughout calls Users can deploy agents via Google Cloud with a shareable URL or export the system prompt to platforms like Vapi or Retell for handling real phone calls https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=36l7oA7HhAM DeepSeek Math V2 Specialized mathematical reasoning model Achieved International Math Olympiad gold-level performance and scoring 118/120 on the 2024 Putnam test The model uses a student-teacher-supervisor framework with self-verification, where it generates proofs, grades its own work, and corrects errors rather than just producing final answers It outperformed Gemini DeepThink on certain benchmarks, reaching 99% accuracy on IMO-ProofBench Basic problems Tencent launched HunyuanOCR , a compact 1Bln params OCR model that beats much larger vision-language models on document understanding tasks HunyuanOCR uses an end-to-end architecture supporting arbitrary resolutions and handles complex documents, tables, and multilingual text across 100+ languages, scoring 94.1 on OmniDocBench and 860 on OCRBench https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mSDsLpMogtM

slides.title: AI Updates 4 How Elon Musk sets and
slides.text: AI Updates 4 How Elon Musk sets and achieves "impossible" goals Interview with Dr. Benjamin Hardy https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p-YTuA7d9WE (1) question all requirements (2) remove unnecessary steps (3) simplify and optimize (4) accelerate learning cycles (5) automate and systematize Ambitious future vision fundamentally shapes present actions and decision-making ("future self") High goals filter out distractions, foster clarity and accountability, and drive true scalability Choose worthy goals, build accountability, and focus on scalable impact rather than maintaining the status quo Traditional SEO vs AI search SEO People are increasingly getting answers from AI tools instead of scrolling through Google results; brands either appear in AI conversations or become invisible Brands must optimize for AI crawlers with new technical requirements like LLM.txt files and structured data Semrush One - a platform that unifies traditional SEO with AI search optimization, allowing marketers to track brand visibility across Google and multiple AI platforms in one dashboard. It monitors over 100 million LLM prompts globally and provides weekly data updates Example: Coalition Technologies achieved a 429% boost in AI referral traffic using these tools https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k_9AsANFY9A

slides.title: AI Updates 5 How to 10x your income
slides.text: AI Updates 5 How to 10x your income Signal-to-noise ratio: identifying the three to five critical tasks you must complete in your next eighteen waking hours, treating everything else as noise Steve Jobs maintained an eighty-twenty ratio, while Elon Musk operates at nearly one hundred percent signal O'Leary emphasizes three keys to entrepreneurial success: (1) projecting confidence before speaking (2) articulating your idea clearly in 90 seconds (3) knowing your numbers precisely He also learned to listen more than he talks, finding silence powerful in negotiations and decision-making Women entrepreneurs in his portfolio achieve goals ninety percent of the time versus men's sixty-five percent, partly because they set achievable targets and maintain better team retention https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mLM9LbRF4Q4 OpenAGI Lux 1.0 AI agent OpenAGI is a San Francisco-based startup Its model Lux Thinker 1.0 can control computers better than systems built by OpenAI and Anthropic - and at a fraction of the cost. The model works by nterpreting screenshots and executing actions across desktop applications https://venturebeat.com/ai/openagi-emerges-from-stealth-with-an-ai-agent-that-it-claims-crushes-openai

slides.title: AI Updates 6 Perplexity = AI chatbot +
slides.text: AI Updates 6 Perplexity = AI chatbot + web search Perplexity stands out for grounding all responses in cited sources, reducing hallucinations and bias compared to other AI tools Deep research mode generates comprehensive reports with 40+ sources Discovery tab for personalized news aggregation Labs for creating interactive dashboards and mini-apps Spaces (similar to custom GPTs) for specialized use cases Automated Tasks for scheduled queries sent via email or WhatsApp Connectors for Google Drive, Dropbox, and WhatsApp The Pro tier costs $20/month and includes unlimited searches, file uploads, and API access Comet is Perplexity's AI browser with assistant capabilities API enables integration with automation tools like Make.com for building complex workflows Ilya Sutskever admits that Scaling is not Enough https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ye_HKsDcVsc Ilya Sutskever admits that Demis Hassabis and DeepMind were right: breakthroughs beyond current scaling are needed to reach true AGI , Today's paradigm is still missing something fundamental despite continually improving with more compute and data All major AI leaders now agree that AGI demands new, poorly understood principles and not just bigger models Sutskever also argues that AGI should be defined by continual learning and adaptability, like a human learning on the job, rather than a finished system capable of everything at launch He sees current secrecy and duplicated effort among labs as slowing progress, but believes even small labs could spark the next breakthrough, and estimates AGI remains 5–20 years away

slides.title: AI Updates 7 OpenAI Code Red Sam Altman
slides.text: AI Updates 7 OpenAI Code Red Sam Altman has announced a "Code Red" due to escalating competition from Google and Anthropic Company will delay new features like ads and AI agents to focus on improving ChatGPT’s core product Google’s Gemini and Anthropic’s Opus models are weakening OpenAI’s lead, especially in reasoning, coding, and image generation OpenAI faces slowing growth and ongoing high cash burn, with future viability dependent on maintaining market share and investor confidence The company's new strategy prioritizes personalization, reliability, and improved user experience https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKddqaqOw8o Anthropic acquires Bun Bun is a high-performance JavaScript runtime (by Jarred Sumner, 2021) Bun's all-in-one toolkit—combining runtime, package manager, bundler, and test runner—delivers significantly faster performance than Node.js and has over 7 million monthly downloads and 82,000 GitHub stars. Claude Code reached $1 Bln in run-rate revenue just six months after its May 2025 public launch; Major clients including Netflix, Spotify, KPMG, and L'Oreal The acquisition will enhance Claude Code's speed and stability while Bun remains open source under MIT license. https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-acquires-bun-as-claude-code-reaches-usd1b-milestone

slides.title: AI Updates 8 OpenCode is an open-source AI
slides.text: AI Updates 8 OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent Runs in your terminal as a free alternative to ClaudeCode and Gemini CLI MGrep integration making it 4x faster and 3x more token-efficient through semantic search of code images and PDFs A new TUI (text-based interface) with improved animations A right-hand panel showing context usage, costs, and LSP info Zed editor extension for one-click installation An OpenCode SDK allowing developers to programmatically control and embed the agent in their own applications The ability to run and visualize TUIs directly within the terminal Multiple session management and a desktop app coming soon It supports various AI models, with free Grok access currently available Includes LSP support, custom commands, and model switching https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ipY_e9sldFM Perplexity "Browse Safe" feature Open‑source detection model designed to protect AI browsing from prompt injection attacks that hide malicious instructions in web pages Currently implemented only in Comet Prompt injection (e.g., instruction override, data exfiltration, misinformation injection). Attackers can manipulate an AI agent to ignore the user’s query, leak data, or return biased or false outputs Browse Safe scans HTML in real time before the AI uses any content, flags suspicious patterns, and filters them so users only see trusted information Perplexity also released BrowseSafe‑Bench, a large benchmark of real‑world attack scenarios, giving developers a standardized way to test and compare prompt‑injection defenses and integrate this layer of security into their own AI tools https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/building-safer-ai-browsers-with-browsesafe https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.20597v1 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AjQGuzYtWyE

slides.title: AI Updates 9 Major updates to Amazon Bedrock
slides.text: AI Updates 9 Major updates to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy controls that set guardrails on agent actions using natural language, intercepting tool calls in milliseconds to verify permissions before execution using automated reasoning for mathematical verification. AgentCore Evaluations provides 13 built-in metrics (correctness, helpfulness, safety, etc.) plus custom evaluators to continuously monitor agent quality in production. Enhanced episodic memory allows agents to learn from successes and failures across all interactions, recognizing patterns to improve future performance. These capabilities are built as first-class citizens into the execution path rather than afterthoughts, enabling production-grade enterprise deployment with automated evaluation, policy enforcement, and learning https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hci2xuWeEQ8 https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2025/12/amazon-bedrock-agentcore-policy-evaluations-preview/ https://techcrunch.com/2025/12/02/aws-announces-new-capabilities-for-its-ai-agent-builder/ Manus Browser Operator It is an AI agent that autonomously controls your browser to complete multi-step tasks like research, form filling, and job applications It works within your existing Chrome or Edge browser using your saved logins and local IP address, avoiding security issues that plague cloud-based tools Examples of usage: extracting data from premium sites like Crunchbase in 8 minutes versus 4 hours manually, managing social media posts and LinkedIn messages, and automating 10 job applications in under 30 minutes Installation takes three steps: install the extension, enable browser access in Manus, and grant permission when prompted The tool operates locally for security, asks authorization before accessing your browser, and uses existing sessions without storing credentials https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7nWVpcCQtfU https://manus.im/features/manus-browser-operator https://manus.im/blog/manus-browser-operator

slides.title: AI Updates 10 Warren Buffett buys $4.3-$4.9 billion
slides.text: AI Updates 10 Warren Buffett buys $4.3-$4.9 billion of Alhpabet (Google) Stock Berkshire Hathaway purchased Alphabet (Google's parent company) stock for the first time in Q3 2024, acquiring 17.9 million shares worth approximately $4.3-$4.9 billion. This was revealed in a regulatory filing on November 14, 2024, and represented Berkshire's only new stock purchase that quarter The investment is particularly notable because it marks Buffett's first-ever position in Google despite the company's 25+ year history, and comes after he previously expressed regret about missing the opportunity to invest in Google earlier. Alphabet became Berkshire's 10th largest equity holding, representing about 1.4% of their total equity portfolio The timing of the purchase coincides with Google's AI momentum, including Gemini 3.0's strong performance, Google Cloud's 34% year-over-year growth, and the company's Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) development. Alphabet was trading at a relatively attractive P/E ratio of around 27-30x compared to other "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks averaging 35-37x https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/undiscussed-reason-buffett-just-bought-alphabet-google-stock https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-11-14/buffett-acquires-4-9-billion-stake-in-google-parent-alphabet Lemon AI - Open-Source Market Research Agent Use text prompt to invoke the research and get the report The agent systematically scans market databases, analyzes thousands of data points, screens stocks or companies based on specified criteria, identifies patterns, and filters out noise automatically Results are delivered as formatted HTML reports with charts, tables, summaries, and actionable insights organized in clear sections The tool enables rapid iteration, allowing users to experiment with different search criteria and explore markets quickly, making it valuable for investors, entrepreneurs, agencies, and researchers who need consistent, thorough market analysis https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=re7JzcU-6N8 https://lemonai.ai

slides.title: Abacus.ai Financial Research DeepAgent by Abacus.ai - a
slides.text: Abacus.ai Financial Research DeepAgent by Abacus.ai - a finance-focused AI system Seven integrated workflows that function like a complete analyst team: 1. crypto analysis 2. intelligent stock screening (fundamentals & technicals) 3. macro market research 4. near-term investment forecasting 5. options strategy construction 6. portfolio risk monitoring 7. 90-day individual stock outlooks Users describe what they need, the agent asks clarifying questions about risk tolerance and time horizon, then builds transparent research reports showing its complete reasoning chain with data sources from CNBC and Investing.com Reports include valuation metrics, financial history, risk analysis, and can be exported as editable HTML. The system represents a shift toward autonomous decision engines accessible to individual investors, mirroring AI-driven research tools major firms like Bloomberg, BlackRock, and JP Morgan already deploy internally https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hzAAzUyILNU https://deepagent.abacus.ai

slides.title: AI trading competition Alpha Arena's Season 1.5 AI
slides.text: AI trading competition Alpha Arena's Season 1.5 AI trading competition just concluded LLMs traded $320,000 in real capital across U.S. stocks like Tesla, Nvidia, and Microsoft A mystery model won with a 12% return using an approach called ProFiT (Program Search for Financial Trading) , which employs evolutionary search similar to Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve and Sakana AI's Darwin Girdle Machine . The system uses LLMs to write and iteratively improve Python trading strategy code through feedback loops, testing against historical data and self-analysis. ProFiT outperformed buy-and-hold strategies in over 77% of experiments. The company behind it, N of One , includes NYU professor Julian Togelius as head of AI. While most competing models lost money, DeepSeek and Gemini performed well in "monk mode" (capital preservation), and the mystery model dominated when given situational awareness of competitors. The approach represents recursive self-improvement where models bootstrap their trading abilities, though real-world profitability remains to be proven over longer timeframes https://nof1.ai/ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EWAUutf9xKQ

slides.title: Use AI to Generate Documentation For contract software
slides.text: Use AI to Generate Documentation For contract software delivery, you'll need 2 types of docs: 1. high-level delivery docs (README, user guides, deployment guides) 2. detailed technical docs (API refs, architecture docs, inline code docs) Recommended Workflow: Use AI to generate doc templates and structure from your codebase Maintain docs alongside your project code in version control Automate updates when code changes Review and refine AI-generated content before client delivery For High-Level Delivery Docs: Generate README files with project overview, setup instructions, and usage examples using AI or tools like DocuWriter Create user guides and deployment docs using Scribe, which captures workflows and generates step-by-step guides with screenshots Generate architecture overviews and system design docs using AI assistants For Technical Docs: Generate API docs from OpenAPI/Swagger specs ( use Apidog, Mintlify, ... ) Create inline code docs / comments using AI Generate database schema docs and technical specs using AI Use Cline (or other code assistants) to generate docs. Use ".clinerules" to define documentation standards and guidelines Prompt example: " Create a comprehensive README.md with installation, configuration, and usage sections based on the codebase " You can ask it to generate API docs, technical design docs, or deployment guides AI can efficiently generate docs (text and diagrams) as Markdown (.md) files. Then convert .md into .pdf , for example " pandoc input.md -o output.pdf" , VSCode, online tools and desktop apps

slides.title: Meta Data Warehouse Agents Meta Data Warehouse Agents
slides.text: Meta Data Warehouse Agents Meta Data Warehouse Agents Meta redesigned its massive data warehouse to handle AI-driven access requests using autonomous AI agents instead of manual approval processes The system addresses three core problems: the complexity of interconnected data relationships, slow multi-approval workflows AI models requiring cross-domain data access that traditional role-based systems couldn't support efficiently. Two-Agent Architecture Data-user agents - three specialized sub-agents coordinated by a triage layer The alternative-suggestion sub-agent recommends safer data alternatives using LLMs to synthesize informal "tribal knowledge." The low-risk exploration sub-agent grants temporary access to small data samples for safe exploration. The access-negotiation sub-agent prepares formal permission requests to data-owner agents. Data-owner agents - handle security and policy enforcement. The security-operations sub-agent applies Standard Operating Procedures to evaluate requests. The access-management sub-agent proactively refines access policies using metadata and historical patterns. Meta transformed the warehouse into a text-navigable hierarchy where every resource (table, dashboard, policy) becomes a text summary that LLMs can process. The system implements context and intention management through automatic context (user identity, resource access), static context (user-defined project scope), dynamic context (metadata-based similarity searches). Intentions are identified explicitly through stated purposes or implicitly through behavioral inference. Access Control Mechanisms - 4 parts: context analysis matching user actions to policies, query-level access control evaluating data exposure risk, daily data-access budgets preventing overexposure, rule-based risk management monitoring agent behavior. Every decision is logged for auditing. The architecture combines LLM-based reasoning with rule-based guardrails to balance productivity and security, enabling both humans and AI agents to collaborate safely at scale.
